items.title: Noah Cook Interview, 1960-09-06
items.q: We had General Murray before Arthur.

ctx.x: Arthur Mike Arthur. Arthur Mike Arthur was the man who was commanding us at that time. We had General Murray before Arthur. But before Murray left. Come back. Before. Because he didn't want no. He didn't want no volunteers. He said volunteers couldn't get to them mountains. To get them goo-goos out of there. And he said to give a. So he sent Mike Arthur over there. Arthur Mike Arthur.
See I wanted to ask you about the. The water cure.
